mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, and ranitidine may have weak histamine-2 receptor blocking effects that could theoretically potentiate MAOI effects; additionally, both drugs can cause CNS effects and there is potential for serotonergic interaction through indirect pathways.
action: Monitor closely for signs of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and excessive CNS depression; consider alternative H2-blocker or proton pump inhibitor if possible; educate patient on dietary tyramine restriction.
